public.text: Sections describing clinical content, service delivery, or point-of-care guidance do not reference WHO SMART Guidelines, despite SMART Guidelines being the mechanism for computable clinical guidance and a natural point of alignment with REDDHI's business services layer.
public.suggestedRevision: Add explicit cross-references to WHO SMART Guidelines wherever REDDHI's business services layer (clinical decision support, etc.) or Services and Applications domain is discussed, specifying how SMART Guidelines content is intended to be consumed within the DPI-H architecture.
